name: SENET
summary: Early SA ISP founded 1994 by Steve Baxter from his Adelaide home; grew to >35,000 customers; acquired by OzEmail/UUNet (SE NETWORK ACCESS PTY LTD, ACN 072 620 243).

events.details: Founded 1994 by Steve Baxter (age 23, ex-Army engineer 1986-1995) from the spare room of his Adelaide home with $11,000 life savings; trading as SE Net / SE Network Access, member of SA Internet Association.
Acquired by OzEmail/UUNet, brand later transferred to iiNet — brand wound into iiNet/OzEmail.

refs.label: Still operating as SE Net (SE Network Access) on 1 Jan 2004.
By Jan 2006 the SE Net brand sat under iiNet/OzEmail and the customer transfer was complete.
Later the domain simply redirected to iiNet.
